input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2(a) imposes a liquidated termination payment on the Company (our party) whenever we terminate. It is calculated as 50% of the preceding twelve months' Net Sales above $800,000, whereas our fees under Section 3.1 are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per month; on a one-year term terminable on 90 days' notice, the payment can substantially exceed both three months' fees and the remaining contract value, and it applies even where we terminate because of HDI's breach. That fails the fallback (early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees) and approaches walk-away territory. Given the parties' revenue-share bargain, we proposed the fallback rather than outright deletion: cap the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees, make it the sole amount payable, and disapply it where we terminate for HDI's breach. The quarterly instalment mechanic in 4.2(c) is unaffected.

proposal.summary: Cap the Company-payable Termination Payment at three months' fees and disapply it where we terminate for HDI's breach
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by the Company, so we have replaced the Net Sales-based formula with our fallback: a termination amount capped at three months' fees, and no such payment where we terminate for HDI's breach. As drafted the payment (50% of Net Sales above $800,000) could far exceed the fees remaining on a one-year, 90-day-notice term.

ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, other than as a result of HDI's breach of this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate fees payable by the Company to HDI pursuant to Section 3.1 in respect of the three (3) calendar months immediately preceding the Termination Date, which amount shall be the sole and exclusive amount payable by the Company in connection with such termination.
